title: D-012/§5.5.1 — the signer refuses; vault paused
note: A conforming purchase submitted while the vault is paused. SIGNER_VAULT_PAUSED is EXECUTABILITY, so the signer refuses to attest and emits a signed refusal record instead of a receipt. The only sample whose receipt.json has refused: true, and the only artifact a third party can use to check that a refusal is authentic and attributable rather than merely asserted.
